head: 461fa9c0
scope: stage M2-V of the oxygen authority: the dilution of pressure venting as one operation of the owner of the room oxygen inventory, with an entry and an exit, behind the same switch, off by default; conservation, ownership, the whole house cases and the cause of the historical gap; an equivalent dilution on the reference content of the room, not a conservation of the mass of gas; no heat fitted to the oxygen (M3), no zonal split (M4), no CO, FED or SVV

historical_route.what: the diagnosis of 2026-10-09 measured again on this tree with the switch off

results.name: W01_venting_left_out_of_the_inventory
results.defect: the venting retires smoke and gases and its dilution never reaches the inventory

results.name: W02_wrong_sign
results.defect: the entry is taken from the room and the exit is given to it

results.name: W03_entry_counted_twice
results.defect: the oxygen that enters is credited twice

results.name: W04_exit_counted_twice
results.defect: the oxygen that leaves is debited twice

results.name: W05_mole_fraction_taken_for_a_mass_fraction
results.defect: the outside mole fraction is multiplied by the mass of gas directly

results.name: W06_clipped_to_the_ceiling_in_silence
results.defect: what the dilution leaves is cut to 0.209, as the historical write does, with no record

results.name: W07_applied_twice
results.defect: one venting event dilutes the room twice

results.name: W08_transit_left_out_of_the_budget
results.defect: a delayed exchange changes the donor and queues nothing for the receiver, while the room vents

results.name: W09_room_number_written_directly
results.defect: with the mode on the venting also writes the room number, as the historical route does

results.name: W10_old_refusal_kept
results.defect: the venting is still a route the owner refuses

results.name: W11_owner_asked_after_writing
results.defect: the owner is not asked before the event writes smoke, gases and pressure: a refused event leaves them written

results.name: W12_accumulator_taken_from_the_number
results.defect: the exterior accumulator of the room is the change of its number by its mass, not what the owner applied

results.name: W13_gas_leaves_at_the_fraction_of_before
results.defect: the gas leaves at the fraction the room had before mixing: the entering mass used directly, which is not the historical law

results.name: W14_selection_built_again_after_the_venting
results.defect: the selections of the step are built again when a room vents

results.name: W15_owner_says_it_would_apply_anything
results.defect: the owner answers that any dilution would apply, so nothing is stopped before the event writes

results.name: W16_entry_and_exit_recorded_as_a_net
results.defect: the event records its net as an entry and no exit

results.name: S01_sink_rebuilds_the_selection
results.defect: the sink builds the selections again in the middle of the step: the one it debits is not the one the fire read

results.name: S02_fire_is_handed_the_lower_number
results.defect: the fire consults the selection and is handed the lower-layer number

results.name: S03_another_deposit_is_debited
results.defect: the sink takes its debit from the lower-layer number and the inventory of the selection is not debited

results.name: S04_second_declaration_of_consumption
results.defect: the write on the upper-layer number is declared as consumption again

results.name: S05_inventory_rewritten_from_the_layers_in_a_sealed_room
results.defect: in a sealed room the blend of the layer numbers is written over the inventory, as the historical route does with the room number

results.name: S06_selection_of_the_previous_step_kept
results.defect: a step opens with the selections of the step before

results.name: S07_selection_ignores_the_transit
results.defect: what a room still owes in transit is left out of what its selection says is available

results.name: S08_historical_route_when_the_selection_is_refused
results.defect: with the mode on, a fire whose selection is refused goes back to reading a layer number

results.name: S09_engine_does_not_hand_the_owner_to_the_fire
results.defect: with the mode on the fire is never told there is a selection and reads as the historical route does

results.name: S10_selection_of_another_step_accepted
results.defect: a debit acts on the selection of an earlier step

results.name: S11_selection_of_another_run_accepted
results.defect: a selection of the run before a reset is not told from one of another step

results.name: S12_selection_of_another_room_accepted
results.defect: the selection of another room is not told from one of another step

results.name: S13_selection_debited_twice
results.defect: the same selection can be debited twice in a step

results.name: S14_another_deposit_accepted
results.defect: a selection that names another deposit debits the room inventory

results.name: S15_fire_blend_with_the_upper_number_armed
results.defect: the mode arms with a fire setting that reads the upper-layer number and would be ignored

results.name: D01_debit_applied_twice
results.defect: the debit of the sink leaves the inventory twice

results.name: T01_transit_omitted
results.defect: a delayed exchange changes the donor and queues nothing for the receiver

results.name: W01_room_number_written_outside_the_owner
results.defect: the final clamp of the engine writes the room number of a room under authority

results.name: C01_credit_without_debit
results.defect: the receiver is credited with oxygen the donor never loses

results.name: R01_transit_inherited_after_a_reset
results.defect: a reset keeps the deliveries of the previous run

results.name: M01_inventory_initialised_with_the_mass_of_gas
results.defect: the mole fraction is multiplied by the mass of gas to get the inventory

results.name: L01_layer_numbers_rewrite_the_inventory
results.defect: the blend of the two layer numbers is written over the inventory

results.name: K01_clip_discarded_without_a_record
results.defect: what the cap of the sink clips is no longer handed to the owner

results.name: M02_parcel_converted_with_the_mass_of_gas
results.defect: the oxygen of a parcel of gas is its mole fraction times its mass

results.name: W02_guard_of_the_room_number_removed
results.defect: any writer can set the room number of a room under authority

results.name: E01_delivery_kept_in_the_queue
results.defect: a delivered entry stays in the queue and comes due again

results.name: E02_second_delivery_not_refused
results.defect: the same delivery can be applied twice

results.name: G01_delivery_of_another_run_accepted
results.defect: a delivery of another run is credited

results.name: P01_transfer_applied_with_a_receiver_that_cannot_pay
results.defect: a transfer the receiver cannot pay is applied: a negative inventory is written

results.name: O01_infiltration_reads_the_room_after_the_sink
results.defect: the infiltration law changes: gas leaves at the number the sink has just lowered

results.name: B01_cap_of_the_sink_on_the_historical_base
results.defect: the cap is 5 % of a mole fraction times a mass of gas, not of the inventory

results.name: X01_exterior_opening_route_not_refused
results.defect: the hot exterior opening is no longer refused by its name

results.name: N01_pressure_network_not_refused
results.defect: the inventory arms with the pressure network on

results.name: F01_refused_inventory_still_simulated
results.defect: a run the inventory refused keeps advancing

results.name: Z01_switch_change_not_refused
results.defect: the switch changes in the middle of a run and the run goes on

results.name: D02_retired_below_the_guards
results.defect: a reset without a building or not ready returns before retiring the inventory and its transit
